instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to bend in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to bend</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: Every day, I bend down to pet my dog.
atoms.b: Every day, I ((bend)) down to pet my dog.

atoms.sound: Last Wednesday, I bent down to pet him about 10 times.
atoms.b: Last Wednesday, I ((bent)) down to pet him about 10 times.

atoms.sound: I have bent down to pet him every day for 5 years.
atoms.b: I have ((bent)) down to pet him every day for 5 years.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to bleed in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to bleed</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: In the winter, my nose often bleeds.
atoms.b: In the winter, my nose often ((bleeds)).

atoms.sound: Luckily, it has never ((bled)) more than three times a day.
atoms.b: Luckily, it has never ((bled)) more than three times a day.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs can in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>can</lang>, in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: I can see the beach from my window.
atoms.b: I ((can)) see the beach from my window.

atoms.sound: Last summer, I could see that most of my friends were at the beach.
atoms.b: Last summer, I ((could)) see that most of my friends were at the beach.

atoms.sound: I have been able to join my friends at the beach this year.
atoms.b: I have ((been able to)) join my friends at the beach this year.

hint.text: Für das Modalverb can gibt es kein echtes past participle. Stattdessen wird bei zusammengesetzten Zeitformen an der Stelle des past participles die Form been able to verwendet.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to shoot in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to shoot</lang> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: Every year, my uncle shoots a new film.
atoms.b: Every year, my uncle ((shoots)) a new film.

atoms.sound: Last year, he shot his film in Canada.
atoms.b: Last year, he ((shot)) his film in Canada.

atoms.sound: He has never shot a film in the USA.
atoms.b: He has never ((shot)) a film in the USA.

instruction.text: Ordne jedem Infinitiv die passenden Formen des simple past und past participle zu.
instruction.sound: Ordne jedem Infinitiv die passenden Formen des <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>simple past</lang> und <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>past participle</lang> zu.
